timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, my name is Chris Gioffellan and I'm running for the State House of Representatives in LD20.
What makes me the best candidate is that I am the product of public education. I have a family
full of teachers. That's why I've been an advocate for public education since the beginning.
I've gotten out the vote for bonds and overrides from South Phoenix to Glendale and volunteered
for every education initiative I could find. And that's why I ran for the State House of Representatives
in 2016, losing by just 3%. Now I'm finding to keep my promise of fully restoring the cuts made
to the public education system since the recession. We need designated funding sources not just
promises in the areas of safety, personnel, facilities and technology, including joint technical
and career education so students graduate ready to enter the workforce. But I also want to
support our small businesses. I ran a business development resource for many years helping
build businesses between law firms and entrepreneurs, entrepreneurs like the one at Glendale Community College
and ASU West. Now I want to make sure our small businesses can compete with our national corporations,
have access to R&D funding to grow and be able to find the employees that they need. Finally,
we need a transparent government and elected officials that are held accountable. I was a newspaper
editor prior to being a lawyer. I follow the dollars, track the impact it had on politicians.
I want to sponsor the legislation to end dark money spending on elections and require
politicians to practically report any financial interests they have when advancing legislation.
Again, my name is Chris Gioffillan and I'm runner for the State House of Representatives in LD-20
and I'm asking for your vote. Let's work together to see that the needs of all Arizona's are met,
our businesses thrive and that our government works for us. You can go to chris4az.com to learn more
and thank you.
